messages.action_next_theme: Switch to the next sound theme
messages.row_own_none: no sounds of its own yet
messages.confirm_delete: Delete the sound theme {name} and all its sounds? This can't be undone.
messages.theme_duplicated: Theme {name} created as a copy of {source}.
messages.imported_skipped: Theme {name} imported with {count} sounds. {skipped} other WAV files were left out.
messages.busy: Please wait, the last import or export is still running.
messages.default_no_folder: The Default theme is Hariku's own sounds and has no folder of its own. Select another theme.
messages.err_name_empty: Type a name for the theme.
messages.err_name_too_long: That name is too long. Use at most {limit} characters.
messages.err_name_invalid: A theme name can't contain < > : " / \ | ? * and can't start or end with a dot.
messages.err_name_reserved: The name {name} is kept for Hariku's own sounds. Choose another name.
messages.err_default_readonly: The Default theme is Hariku's own sounds and can't be changed. Make a new theme, or duplicate this one, first.
messages.err_unknown_sound: {name} is not one of Hariku's sounds.
messages.err_too_big: That file is too large. A sound can be at most {limit_mb} MB.
messages.err_not_wav: That file is not a WAV sound Hariku can play. Choose an uncompressed PCM WAV file.
messages.err_file_unreadable: Hariku could not read that file.
messages.err_io: Hariku could not change the theme's files. Make sure no other program is using them, then try again.
messages.err_delete_active: Theme {name} is in use. Use another theme first, then delete this one.
messages.err_no_other_themes: There are no other sound themes. Make one in Preferences, Sound Themes.
messages.err_archive_unreadable: Hariku could not read that file. Choose a ZIP file of WAV sounds or a Hariku 1 sound theme.
messages.err_archive_unsafe: That ZIP file has entries that point outside its own folder, so Hariku won't open it.
messages.err_archive_too_large: That file holds more than {limit_mb} MB of sounds, which is too much to import.
messages.err_archive_no_sounds: That file has no sounds Hariku can use. Sounds must be WAV files named like Hariku's sounds, for example confirm.wav.
messages.err_archive_all_default: Every sound in that theme is the same as Hariku's own, so there is nothing to import.
messages.err_export_empty: Theme {name} has no sounds of its own to export yet.
